rows.note: Use this for figurative attraction when something draws someone in involuntarily.

example.english: I was magnetically drawn to this series and watched the whole thing.
example.traditional: 我不自覺咁畀呢套劇吸引住，追晒成套。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bat1 zi6 gok3 gam3 bei2 ni1 tou3 kek6 kap1 jan5 zyu6 zeoi1 saai3 seng4 tou3

rows.note: Use this as the straightforward choice for an action carried out by magnetic force.

example.english: The iron plate is held magnetically to the board.
example.traditional: 塊鐵片係靠磁力吸住喺塊板上面。
example.jyutping: faai3 tit3 pin3 hai6 kaau3 ci4 lik6 kap1 zyu6 hai2 faai3 baan2 soeng6 min6
